name: kingdom
description: Multi-agent orchestration kit for Claude Code — parallel AI coding with Git worktrees and native cmux.app. A King (👑 Opus) coordinates generic workers (👷), co-workers (🧑‍💼), and watchmen (🕵️) — each in its own cmux.app workspace with role-coloured sidebar badges, native notifications, live state lines, and manual attention-badge overrides. Three-tier hierarchy: Workspace per master, Tab for visible sub-agent spawns, Split for predefined dual-view. Model-tiered sub-agent spawn defaults (haiku/sonnet → background; opus → tab) keep fan-outs fast. King reads ALL context at session start; uses watchman outputs at every decision point; auto-fires the pre-commit gate on every un-gated sentinel; ALWAYS merges into the local kingdom branch for review BEFORE asking 'push?' (mandatory staging — Ter reviews the integrated diff, then push happens by carving feature/* from the lane tip). Workers are interchangeable capacity; King assigns task scope per-dispatch. Domain-agnostic: code, research, finance, science, manuscripts. Bootstrap with /kingdom:init; spawn with /kingdom:start; audit with /kingdom:update; close with /kingdom:exit. Per-task multi-layer task files + 4/5-step closer artifact pipeline. Won't touch your project files, develop/main branches, shell config, or git config.
